name: adw-gtk3
summary: The libadwaita look ported to GTK 3, so older apps match modern GNOME-style apps
description: adw-gtk3 is a GTK 3 theme that mirrors the libadwaita style used by modern GTK 4 apps, in light and dark variants. Install it and select adw-gtk3 or adw-gtk3-dark as your GTK theme so older apps match the rest of your desktop.
